official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
TonalBrain makes mixing plugins for your DAW.

TonalBrain Mix measures every track in your session and sets EQ, compression, panning and effects for each one. Ask your assistant about your latest analysis: why the bass got a cut at 250 Hz, why the kick is compressed more than the snare, or what makes the vocal brighter. The assistant reads the settings TonalBrain chose for each track and shows the EQ curve and module settings of every track. These tools are read-only: they cannot start an analysis or use credits.

TonalBrain Track is a channel strip (EQ, compressor, opto, de-esser, tape, exciter, stereo width) on one track. Press Capture in the plugin, then ask your assistant to mix the track. The assistant reads rounded findings about the track (tone by octave, dynamics, low end, highs, stereo) and sends settings to the plugin. The plugin applies them while its window is open in your DAW. TonalBrain checks every setting before the plugin applies it, and you can change or undo anything in the plugin.

TonalBrain never sends audio. Requires a TonalBrain account. Mix questions need at least one analysis; setting a Track strip needs a TonalBrain Track licence.
